verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אֶפְרַ֗יִם וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜יו מָֽה־ הַדָּבָ֤ר עָשִׂ֣יתָ הַזֶּה֙ לָּ֔נוּ לְבִלְתִּי֙ קְרֹ֣אות לָ֔נוּ כִּ֥י הָלַ֖כְתָּ לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם בְּמִדְיָ֑ן וַיְרִיב֥וּן אִתּ֖וֹ בְּחָזְקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’ep̄·ra·yim way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw māh- had·dā·ḇār ‘ā·śî·ṯā haz·zeh lā·nū lə·ḇil·tî qə·rō·wṯ lā·nū kî hā·laḵ·tā lə·hil·lā·ḥêm bə·miḏ·yān way·rî·ḇūn ’it·tōw bə·ḥā·zə·qāh
verses.literal: Then the men of Ephraim said to [Gideon] Why . . . have you done this to us Why did you fail to call us when you went to fight against Midian And they contended with him violently . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם עַתָּ֖ה מֶה־ עָשִׂ֥יתִי כָּכֶ֑ם הֲל֗וֹא עֹלְל֥וֹת אֶפְרַ֖יִם ט֛וֹב מִבְצִ֥יר אֲבִיעֶֽזֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ‘at·tāh meh- ‘ā·śî·ṯî kā·ḵem hă·lō·w ‘ō·lə·lō·wṯ ’ep̄·ra·yim ṭō·wḇ miḇ·ṣîr ’ă·ḇî·‘e·zer
verses.literal: But [Gideon] answered them Now what have I accomplished compared to you Are not the gleanings of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־ נָתַ֨ן עֹרֵ֣ב וְאֶת־ זְאֵ֔ב שָׂרֵ֤י מִדְיָן֙ בְּיֶדְכֶם֩ אֶת־ וּמַה־ יָּכֹ֖לְתִּי עֲשׂ֣וֹת כָּכֶ֑ם אָ֗ז בְּדַבְּר֖וֹ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃ רוּחָם֙ מֵֽעָלָ֔יו רָפְתָ֤ה
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- nā·ṯan ‘ō·rêḇ wə·’eṯ- zə·’êḇ śā·rê miḏ·yān bə·yeḏ·ḵem ’eṯ- ū·mah- yā·ḵō·lə·tî ‘ă·śō·wṯ kā·ḵem ’āz bə·ḏab·bə·rōw had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh rū·ḥām mê·‘ā·lāw rā·p̄ə·ṯāh
verses.literal: God - has delivered Oreb and Zeeb the two princes of Midian into your hand - What was I able to do compared to you . . . When he had said . . . this their anger against him subsided

verses.original: גִדְע֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֤וֹת הָאִישׁ֙ וַיָּבֹ֥א הַיַּרְדֵּ֑נָה עֹבֵ֣ר ה֗וּא עֲיֵפִ֖ים וְרֹדְפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn ’ă·šer ’it·tōw ū·šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ hā·’îš way·yā·ḇō hay·yar·dê·nāh ‘ō·ḇêr hū ‘ă·yê·p̄îm wə·rō·ḏə·p̄îm
verses.literal: Then Gideon - and his three hundred men came to the Jordan [and] crossed it . . . exhausted yet still in pursuit

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְאַנְשֵׁ֣י סֻכּ֔וֹת נָא֙ תְּנוּ־ לָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּרַגְלָ֑י כִּכְּר֣וֹת לֶ֔חֶם כִּי־ הֵ֔ם עֲיֵפִ֣ים וְאָנֹכִ֗י רֹדֵ֛ף אַחֲרֵ֛י זֶ֥בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֖ע מַלְכֵ֥י מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·’an·šê suk·kō·wṯ nā tə·nū- lā·‘ām ’ă·šer bə·raḡ·lāy kik·kə·rō·wṯ le·ḥem kî- hêm ‘ă·yê·p̄îm wə·’ā·nō·ḵî rō·ḏêp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ mal·ḵê miḏ·yān
verses.literal: So [Gideon] said to the men of Succoth Please give my troops - - some bread for they are exhausted and I am still pursuing . . . Zebah and Zalmunna the kings of Midian

verses.original: שָׂרֵ֣י סֻכּ֔וֹת וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הֲ֠כַף זֶ֧בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֛ע עַתָּ֖ה בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ נִתֵּ֥ן לָֽחֶם׃ לִֽצְבָאֲךָ֖
verses.transliteration: śā·rê suk·kō·wṯ way·yō·mer hă·ḵap̄ ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ ‘at·tāh bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā kî- nit·tên lā·ḥem liṣ·ḇā·’ă·ḵā
verses.literal: But the leaders of Succoth asked [Are] the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession that we should give bread to your army

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן גִּדְע֔וֹן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ בְּתֵ֧ת זֶ֥בַח וְאֶת־ צַלְמֻנָּ֖ע בְּיָדִ֑י וְדַשְׁתִּי֙ אֶת־ בְּשַׂרְכֶ֔ם אֶת־ קוֹצֵ֥י הַֽבַּרְקֳנִֽים׃ הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְאֶת־
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên giḏ·‘ō·wn way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’eṯ- bə·ṯêṯ ze·ḇaḥ wə·’eṯ- ṣal·mun·nā‘ bə·yā·ḏî wə·ḏaš·tî ’eṯ- bə·śar·ḵem ’eṯ- qō·w·ṣê hab·bar·qo·nîm ham·miḏ·bār wə·’eṯ-
verses.literal: Very well Gideon replied when the LORD - has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand I will tear - your flesh with the thorns and briers of the wilderness . . .

verses.original: מִשָּׁם֙ וַיַּ֤עַל פְּנוּאֵ֔ל וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר כָּזֹ֑את אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם אַנְשֵׁ֣י פְנוּאֵ֔ל וַיַּעֲנ֤וּ אוֹתוֹ֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָנ֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י סֻכּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: miš·šām way·ya·‘al pə·nū·’êl way·ḏab·bêr kā·zōṯ ’ă·lê·hem ’an·šê p̄ə·nū·’êl way·ya·‘ă·nū ’ō·w·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·nū ’an·šê suk·kō·wṯ
verses.literal: From there he went up to Penuel and asked the same from them but the men of Penuel gave the same response - as - the men of Succoth

verses.original: גַּם־ וַיֹּ֛אמֶר לְאַנְשֵׁ֥י פְנוּאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בְּשׁוּבִ֣י בְשָׁל֔וֹם אֶתֹּ֖ץ אֶת־ הַזֶּֽה׃פ הַמִּגְדָּ֥ל
verses.transliteration: gam- way·yō·mer lə·’an·šê p̄ə·nū·’êl lê·mōr bə·šū·ḇî ḇə·šā·lō·wm ’et·tōṣ ’eṯ- haz·zeh ham·miḡ·dāl
verses.literal: So [Gideon] told the men of Penuel . . . When I return in triumph I will tear down - this tower

verses.original: וְזֶ֨בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֜ע בַּקַּרְקֹ֗ר עִמָּם֙ וּמַחֲנֵיהֶ֤ם כַּחֲמֵ֤שֶׁת עָשָׂר֙ אֶ֔לֶף כֹּ֚ל הַנּ֣וֹתָרִ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל מַחֲנֵ֣ה בְנֵי־ קֶ֑דֶם מֵאָ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חָֽרֶב׃ וְהַנֹּ֣פְלִ֔ים
verses.transliteration: wə·ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ baq·qar·qōr ‘im·mām ū·ma·ḥă·nê·hem ka·ḥă·mê·šeṯ ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ kōl han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm mik·kōl ma·ḥă·nêh ḇə·nê- qe·ḏem mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’îš šō·lêp̄ ḥā·reḇ wə·han·nō·p̄ə·lîm
verses.literal: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with their army of about fifteen . . . thousand [men] all that were left of the armies of the people of the east A hundred and twenty thousand swordsmen . . . . . . had already fallen

verses.original: גִּדְע֗וֹן וַיַּ֣עַל הַשְּׁכוּנֵ֣י בָֽאֳהָלִ֔ים דֶּ֚רֶךְ מִקֶּ֥דֶם לְנֹ֖בַח וְיָגְבֳּהָ֑ה וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְהַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה הָ֥יָה בֶֽטַח׃
verses.transliteration: giḏ·‘ō·wn way·ya·‘al haš·šə·ḵū·nê ḇā·’o·hā·lîm de·reḵ miq·qe·ḏem lə·nō·ḇaḥ wə·yā·ḡə·bo·hāh way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ham·ma·ḥă·neh wə·ham·ma·ḥă·neh hā·yāh ḇe·ṭaḥ
verses.literal: And Gideon went up by way of the caravan . . . route east of Nobah and Jogbehah and he attacked - their army [taking them] vvv by surprise

verses.original: זֶ֚בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֔ע וַיָּנ֗וּסוּ וַיִּרְדֹּ֖ף אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּלְכֹּ֞ד אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֣י׀ מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן אֶת־ זֶ֙בַח֙ וְאֶת־ צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע הֶחֱרִֽיד׃ וְכָל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ way·yā·nū·sū way·yir·dōp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê·hem way·yil·kōḏ ’eṯ- šə·nê mal·ḵê miḏ·yān ’eṯ- ze·ḇaḥ wə·’eṯ- ṣal·mun·nā‘ he·ḥĕ·rîḏ wə·ḵāl ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: When Zebah and Zalmunna fled [Gideon] pursued . . . and captured - these two kings of Midian - - - - routing their entire army

verses.original: גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ וַיָּ֛שָׁב מִן־ הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה מִֽלְמַעֲלֵ֖ה הֶחָֽרֶס׃
verses.transliteration: giḏ·‘ō·wn ben- yō·w·’āš way·yā·šāḇ min- ham·mil·ḥā·māh mil·ma·‘ă·lêh he·ḥā·res
verses.literal: After this, Gideon son of Joash returned from the battle along the Ascent of Heres

verses.original: וַיִּלְכָּד־ נַ֛עַר מֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י סֻכּ֖וֹת וַיִּשְׁאָלֵ֑הוּ וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב אֵלָ֜יו אֶת־ שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה אִֽישׁ׃ שָׂרֵ֤י וְאֶת־ זְקֵנֶ֔יהָ סֻכּוֹת֙
verses.transliteration: way·yil·kāḏ- na·‘ar mê·’an·šê suk·kō·wṯ way·yiš·’ā·lê·hū way·yiḵ·tōḇ ’ê·lāw ’eṯ- šiḇ·‘îm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’îš śā·rê wə·’eṯ- zə·qê·ne·hā suk·kō·wṯ
verses.literal: There he captured a young man . . . of Succoth and interrogated him The young man wrote down for him - the names of the seventy-seven . . . - leaders and elders of Succoth

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י סֻכּ֔וֹת וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֖ה זֶ֣בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר֩ חֵרַפְתֶּ֨ם אוֹתִ֜י לֵאמֹ֗ר הֲ֠כַף זֶ֣בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֤ע עַתָּה֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י נִתֵּ֛ן לָֽחֶם׃ הַיְּעֵפִ֖ים לַאֲנָשֶׁ֥יךָ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’el- ’an·šê suk·kō·wṯ way·yō·mer hin·nêh ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ ’ă·šer ḥê·rap̄·tem ’ō·w·ṯî lê·mōr hă·ḵap̄ ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ ‘at·tāh bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā kî nit·tên lā·ḥem hay·yə·‘ê·p̄îm la·’ă·nā·še·ḵā
verses.literal: And [Gideon] went to the men of Succoth and said Here are Zebah and Zalmunna about whom you taunted me saying [Are] the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession that we should give bread to your weary men

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־ זִקְנֵ֣י הָעִ֔יר וְאֶת־ קוֹצֵ֥י הַֽבַּרְקֳנִ֑ים הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְאֶת־ בָּהֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת וַיֹּ֣דַע אַנְשֵׁ֥י סֻכּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ziq·nê hā·‘îr wə·’eṯ- qō·w·ṣê hab·bar·qo·nîm ham·miḏ·bār wə·’eṯ- bā·hem ’êṯ way·yō·ḏa‘ ’an·šê suk·kō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then he took - the elders of the city and [using] the thorns and briers of the wilderness - - - he disciplined the men of Succoth

verses.original: וְאֶת־ נָתָ֑ץ מִגְדַּ֥ל פְּנוּאֵ֖ל וַֽיַּהֲרֹ֖ג אֶת־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- nā·ṯāṣ miḡ·dal pə·nū·’êl way·ya·hă·rōḡ ’eṯ- ’an·šê hā·‘îr
verses.literal: - He also pulled down the tower of Penuel and killed - the men of the city

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל־ זֶ֙בַח֙ וְאֶל־ צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע אֵיפֹה֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲרַגְתֶּ֖ם בְּתָב֑וֹר כָּמ֣וֹךָ כְמוֹהֶ֔ם וַֽיֹּאמרוּ֙ אֶחָ֕ד כְּתֹ֖אַר בְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- ze·ḇaḥ wə·’el- ṣal·mun·nā‘ ’ê·p̄ōh hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer hă·raḡ·tem bə·ṯā·ḇō·wr kā·mō·w·ḵā ḵə·mō·w·hem way·yō·m·rū ’e·ḥāḏ kə·ṯō·’ar bə·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Next, [Gideon] asked . . . Zebah . . . and Zalmunna What kind of men - did you kill at Tabor Men like you . . . they answered [each] one resembling the son of a king

verses.original: הֵ֑ם אַחַ֥י וַיֹּאמַ֕ר בְּנֵֽי־ אִמִּ֖י יְהוָ֗ה חַי־ ל֚וּ הַחֲיִתֶ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם לֹ֥א הָרַ֖גְתִּי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hêm ’a·ḥay way·yō·mar bə·nê- ’im·mî Yah·weh ḥay- lū ha·ḥă·yi·ṯem ’ō·w·ṯām lō hā·raḡ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: They were my brothers Gideon replied the sons of my mother As surely as the LORD lives if you had let them live - I would not kill you

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְיֶ֣תֶר בְּכוֹר֔וֹ ק֖וּם הֲרֹ֣ג אוֹתָ֑ם הַנַּ֤עַר וְלֹא־ שָׁלַ֨ף חַרְבּוֹ֙ כִּ֣י יָרֵ֔א כִּ֥י עוֹדֶ֖נּוּ נָֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·ye·ṯer bə·ḵō·w·rōw qūm hă·rōḡ ’ō·w·ṯām han·na·‘ar wə·lō- šā·lap̄ ḥar·bōw kî yā·rê kî ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū nā·‘ar
verses.literal: So he said to Jether his firstborn Get up and kill them - But the young man did not draw his sword - he was fearful because he was still a youth

verses.original: זֶ֣בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע וַיֹּ֜אמֶר ק֤וּם וּפְגַע־ בָּ֔נוּ אַתָּה֙ כִּ֥י כָאִ֖ישׁ גְּבוּרָת֑וֹ גִּדְע֗וֹן וַיָּ֣קָם וַֽיַּהֲרֹג֙ אֶת־ זֶ֣בַח וְאֶת־ צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־ הַשַּׂ֣הֲרֹנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּצַוְּארֵ֥י גְמַלֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ way·yō·mer qūm ū·p̄ə·ḡa‘- bā·nū ’at·tāh kî ḵā·’îš gə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw giḏ·‘ō·wn way·yā·qām way·ya·hă·rōḡ ’eṯ- ze·ḇaḥ wə·’eṯ- ṣal·mun·nā‘ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- haś·śa·hă·rō·nîm ’ă·šer bə·ṣaw·wə·rê ḡə·mal·lê·hem
verses.literal: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said Get up and kill us yourself for as the man is so is his strength So Gideon got up and killed - Zebah - and Zalmunna and he took - the crescent ornaments - from the necks of their camels

verses.original: אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל־ גִּדְע֔וֹן מְשָׁל־ בָּ֙נוּ֙ אַתָּ֔ה גַּם־ בִּנְךָ֖ גַּ֣ם גַּם־ בֶּן־ בְּנֶ֑ךָ כִּ֥י הוֹשַׁעְתָּ֖נוּ מִיַּ֥ד מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mə·rū ’el- giḏ·‘ō·wn mə·šāl- bā·nū ’at·tāh gam- bin·ḵā gam gam- ben- bə·ne·ḵā kî hō·wō·ša‘·tā·nū mî·yaḏ miḏ·yān
verses.literal: Then the Israelites . . . said to Gideon Rule over us you and your son . . . and grandson . . . for you have saved us from the hand of Midian

verses.original: גִּדְע֔וֹן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אֲנִי֙ לֹֽא־ אֶמְשֹׁ֤ל בָּכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ יִמְשֹׁ֥ל בְּנִ֖י בָּכֶ֑ם יְהוָ֖ה יִמְשֹׁ֥ל בָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: giḏ·‘ō·wn way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’ă·nî lō- ’em·šōl bā·ḵem wə·lō- yim·šōl bə·nî bā·ḵem Yah·weh yim·šōl bā·ḵem
verses.literal: But Gideon replied . . . I will not rule over you nor will my son - The LORD shall rule over you

verses.original: גִּדְע֗וֹן וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם אֶשְׁאֲלָ֤ה שְׁאֵלָ֔ה מִכֶּם֙ אִ֖ישׁ וּתְנוּ־ לִ֕י נֶ֣זֶם שְׁלָל֑וֹ כִּֽי־ זָהָב֙ לָהֶ֔ם נִזְמֵ֤י כִּ֥י הֵֽם׃ יִשְׁמְעֵאלִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: giḏ·‘ō·wn way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’eš·’ă·lāh šə·’ê·lāh mik·kem ’îš ū·ṯə·nū- lî ne·zem šə·lā·lōw kî- zā·hāḇ lā·hem niz·mê kî hêm yiš·mə·‘ê·lîm
verses.literal: Then he added - Let me make a request . . . of you that each of you give me an earring from his plunder For [the enemies] had gold earrings because they were Ishmaelites

verses.original: נָת֣וֹן נִתֵּ֑ן וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ וַֽיִּפְרְשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ הַשִּׂמְלָ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ וַיַּשְׁלִ֣יכוּ נֶ֥זֶם שְׁלָלֽוֹ׃ שָׁ֔מָּה
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯō·wn nit·tên way·yō·mə·rū way·yip̄·rə·śū ’eṯ- haś·śim·lāh ’îš way·yaš·lî·ḵū ne·zem šə·lā·lōw šām·māh
verses.literal: We will give [them] gladly . . . they replied So they spread out - a garment and each man threw an earring from his plunder onto it

verses.original: מִשְׁקַ֞ל הַזָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִזְמֵ֤י שָׁאָ֔ל וַיְהִ֗י אֶ֥לֶף וּשְׁבַע־ מֵא֖וֹת זָהָ֑ב לְ֠בַד מִן־ הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִ֨ים וְהַנְּטִפ֜וֹת הָאַרְגָּמָ֗ן וּבִגְדֵ֣י שֶׁעַל֙ מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֔ן וּלְבַד֙ מִן־ הָ֣עֲנָק֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּצַוְּארֵ֥י גְמַלֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miš·qal haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer niz·mê šā·’āl way·hî ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘- mê·’ō·wṯ zā·hāḇ lə·ḇaḏ min- haś·śa·hă·rō·nîm wə·han·nə·ṭi·p̄ō·wṯ hā·’ar·gā·mān ū·ḇiḡ·ḏê še·‘al mal·ḵê miḏ·yān ū·lə·ḇaḏ min- hā·‘ă·nā·qō·wṯ ’ă·šer bə·ṣaw·wə·rê ḡə·mal·lê·hem
verses.literal: The weight of the gold - earrings he had requested was 1 ,700 . . . . . . [shekels] in addition to . . . the crescent ornaments the pendants the purple garments of the kings of Midian . . . . . . and the chains - from the necks of their camels

verses.original: גִדְע֜וֹן וַיַּעַשׂ֩ אוֹת֨וֹ לְאֵפ֗וֹד וַיַּצֵּ֨ג אוֹת֤וֹ בְּעָפְרָ֔ה בְעִירוֹ֙ כָֽל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וַיִּזְנ֧וּ אַחֲרָ֖יו שָׁ֑ם וַיְהִ֛י לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃ לְגִדְע֥וֹן וּלְבֵית֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn way·ya·‘aś ’ō·w·ṯōw lə·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ way·yaṣ·ṣêḡ ’ō·w·ṯōw bə·‘ā·p̄ə·rāh ḇə·‘î·rōw ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl way·yiz·nū ’a·ḥă·rāw šām way·hî lə·mō·w·qêš lə·ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn ū·lə·ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: [From all this] Gideon made - an ephod which he placed - in Ophrah his hometown But soon all Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there and it became a snare to Gideon and his household

verses.original: מִדְיָ֗ן וַיִּכָּנַ֣ע לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א לָשֵׂ֣את רֹאשָׁ֑ם יָסְפ֖וּ הָאָ֛רֶץ וַתִּשְׁקֹ֥ט אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בִּימֵ֥י גִדְעֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: miḏ·yān way·yik·kā·na‘ lip̄·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō lā·śêṯ rō·šām yā·sə·p̄ū hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tiš·qōṭ ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh bî·mê ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: In this way Midian was subdued before the Israelites . . . and did not raise its head again So the land had rest for forty years in the days of Gideon

verses.original: יְרֻבַּ֥עַל בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃ וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב
verses.transliteration: yə·rub·ba·‘al ben- yō·w·’āš way·yê·leḵ bə·ḇê·ṯōw way·yê·šeḇ
verses.literal: and he — Jerubbaal son of Joash returned home and settled down

verses.original: וּלְגִדְע֗וֹן הָיוּ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים בָּנִ֔ים יֹצְאֵ֖י יְרֵכ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ הָ֥יוּ לֽוֹ׃ רַבּ֖וֹת נָשִׁ֥ים
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn hā·yū šiḇ·‘îm bā·nîm yō·ṣə·’ê yə·rê·ḵōw kî- hā·yū lōw rab·bō·wṯ nā·šîm
verses.literal: Gideon had seventy sons of his own . . . since he had many wives

verses.original: וּפִֽילַגְשׁוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁכֶ֔ם גַם־ הִ֖יא יָֽלְדָה־ לּ֥וֹ בֵּ֑ן וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄î·laḡ·šōw ’ă·šer biš·ḵem ḡam- hî yā·lə·ḏāh- lōw bên way·yā·śem ’eṯ- šə·mōw ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ
verses.literal: His concubine who [dwelt] in Shechem also . . . bore him a son and he named - him Abimelech

verses.original: גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ וַיָּ֛מָת טוֹבָ֑ה בְּשֵׂיבָ֣ה וַיִּקָּבֵ֗ר בְּקֶ֙בֶר֙ אָבִ֔יו יוֹאָ֣שׁ בְּעָפְרָ֖ה אֲבִ֥י הָֽעֶזְרִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: giḏ·‘ō·wn ben- yō·w·’āš way·yā·māṯ ṭō·w·ḇāh bə·śê·ḇāh way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·qe·ḇer ’ā·ḇîw yō·w·’āš bə·‘ā·p̄ə·rāh ’ă·ḇî hā·‘ez·rî
verses.literal: Later, Gideon son of Joash died at a ripe old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah vvv of the Abiezrites

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ גִּדְע֔וֹן מֵ֣ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיָּשׁ֙וּבוּ֙ וַיִּזְנ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַבְּעָלִ֑ים וַיָּשִׂ֧ימוּ לָהֶ֛ם בַּ֥עַל בְּרִ֖ית לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer giḏ·‘ō·wn mêṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·šū·ḇū way·yiz·nū ’a·ḥă·rê hab·bə·‘ā·lîm way·yā·śî·mū lā·hem ba·‘al bə·rîṯ lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: And as soon as Gideon was dead the Israelites . . . turned and prostituted themselves with the Baals and they set up vvv Baal-berith as their god

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ וְלֹ֤א זָֽכְרוּ֙ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם הַמַּצִּ֥יל אוֹתָ֛ם מִיַּ֥ד כָּל־ אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- wə·lō zā·ḵə·rū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ham·maṣ·ṣîl ’ō·w·ṯām mî·yaḏ kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . - failed to remember the LORD their God who had delivered them from the hands of all their enemies on every side

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ עָשׂ֣וּ חֶ֔סֶד עִם־ בֵּ֥ית יְרֻבַּ֖עַל גִּדְע֑וֹן כְּכָל־ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ‘ā·śū ḥe·seḏ ‘im- bêṯ yə·rub·ba·‘al giḏ·‘ō·wn kə·ḵāl- haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: They did not show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon for all the good things - he had done for Israel
